title: Render versioned skill invocation envelopes
objective: Standardize full SKILL.md injection, already-loaded acknowledgements, and superseded-version notices using ID, revision, and digest.
context: Implement the accepted hybrid design: an initial developer-role catalog snapshot, append-only upsert/revoke deltas, on-demand SKILL.md bodies, and an authoritative execution registry.
The repository is a dirty shared worktree. Preserve unrelated changes and modify only owned_files.

source_evidence.note: Codex uses a bounded initial metadata catalog and loads full SKILL.md on demand.
Claude Code supports live skill discovery, visibility overrides, and on-demand skill bodies.
Append-only conversation messages preserve the previously cached prompt prefix.

include: Render full body envelopes with stable ID, revision, digest, source, and locator.
Render a short acknowledgement for an identical already-loaded digest.
Render a superseding envelope when the content digest changes.
exclude: Do not modify files owned by another task.
Do not add dependencies or perform unrelated refactors.

implementation_steps: Add escaping and large/unicode body tests.
Keep permission and registry lookup out of this package.
acceptance_criteria: Same digest can be represented without duplicating the full body.
Changed digest clearly supersedes the prior version.
Envelope output contains no mutable global state.
dispatch_prompt: Implement pure versioned skill invocation envelope rendering in new files. Do not modify SkillTool or compaction.
notes_for_assignee: Keep the diff narrow; if a dependency contract is insufficient, report the required change to the integrator instead of editing another task's files.
